assertions: The revision binds one exact intended backend date even when the player-facing display is less precise.
Exact date, month-year, quarter, year and Coming Soon map to the official upcoming-list placement semantics without generating localized copy.

Changing the exact intended date inside the observed two-week lock window is blocked.
Released, stale, future, unreviewed and short-window states are blocked rather than treated as platform truth.
Store/build readiness and supplied evidence remain caller assertions pending human review; the Connector does not authenticate Steamworks.
The result cannot claim a Steamworks save, Coming Soon change, Release App click, release, wishlist notification or execution authorization.
